name: deepseek-balance
description: Show DeepSeek API account balance inside Codex through a native MCP plugin.

interface.shortDescription: View your DeepSeek API balance in Codex.
interface.longDescription: A Codex MCP plugin that reads the official DeepSeek balance API using your own API key and renders the remaining balance as an inline card.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my DeepSeek API balance is available.
